name: oats-monorepo
description: Oats and the apps built on the same code: apps/* are the products, shared/ is the code they share

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:native && npm run dist:mac -w oats
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/copy-vcruntime.mjs && npm run dist:win -w oats
scripts.dist:mac-x64: ./scripts/build-tcc.sh && npm run deps:mac-x64 && npm run dist:mac-x64 -w oats
